purpose: Regression reproduction before Counter origin certificate fix; no performance claim
setup: Before importing memory_book.text, replace collections.Counter.__missing__ with @functools.wraps(original) wrapper returning original(self, key) + 10 and recording calls. Compare public excerpt with _NATIVE=None versus the default native module.

observed.text: alpha alpha chosen. unrelated filler text. unrelated filler text. unrelated filler text. unrelated filler text. unrelated filler text. beta late.

diagnosis: Mutable __module__/__name__ metadata caused a pre-import Python wrapper to be certified as the original Counter implementation. Native window execution bypassed the overridden Counter behavior.
proposed_fix: Require the actual FunctionType, code.co_name, code.co_filename == collections.__file__, and function.__globals__ is collections.__dict__, plus runtime identity. Retain Python behavior for uncertified methods.
